|---|---|---|
| [ActivityTray.tsx](ActivityTray.tsx.md) | current | The actions in flight on every page: what each is doing now, how far it has measurably got, and how long it has taken. It sits above dialogs. |
| [LiveBar.tsx](LiveBar.tsx.md) | current | A progress bar that only fills as far as a measured value says. With no measure (`value` null) it shows a travelling segment (`progress-indeterminate`) instead of guessing. |
| [LiveProgress.tsx](LiveProgress.tsx.md) | current | Live numbers for the app's loaders, so a spinner never sits there alone. |
| [TopProgressBar.tsx](TopProgressBar.tsx.md) | current | The strip along the top of every page: page data loading and actions in flight, filled only as far as they have measurably got. |
| [usePageLoad.ts](usePageLoad.ts.md) | current | Tracks the burst of page-data fetches (React Query) so that loaders can show a real percentage. |
